title: Rust: Boolean Logic
description: Use logical operators AND (&&), OR (||), and NOT (!) in Rust.

steps.title: AND Operator
steps.description: Evaluate `true && true`, `true && false`, and `false && false`. Print each result.

verification.failureMessage: Print results of all three AND combinations.

steps.title: OR Operator
steps.description: Evaluate `true || false`, `false || true`, and `false || false`. Print each result.
hints: OR is `true` if at least one operand is `true`.

verification.failureMessage: Print results of all three OR combinations.

steps.title: NOT Operator
steps.description: Apply the NOT operator `!` to `true` and `false`. Print both results.

steps.title: Combined Logic
steps.description: Evaluate `(true && false) || true` and `!(true && true)`. Print both results.
hints: Use parentheses to control evaluation order.

verification.failureMessage: Evaluate both combined expressions and print the results.

steps.title: Short-Circuit Evaluation
steps.description: Show short-circuit evaluation: evaluate `false && println!("won't print");` and `true || println!("won't print either");`. Print a message after each to prove short-circuiting.
hints: In `false && anything`, the right side never executes (short-circuit).
In `true || anything`, the right side never executes.
Use `println!` to see which expressions actually run.
